label: Garbage / waste issue
submitChecklist: Ward or neighbourhood name if known

routing.reason: Garbage and solid waste on public areas is typically handled by the local municipal corporation's sanitation or solid waste management department.

label: Road damage / pothole
submitChecklist: Whether it poses immediate danger to traffic

routing.reason: National highways are maintained by NHAI, not the local municipality.
State highways are typically maintained by the state Public Works Department (PWD).
Local residential and municipal roads are maintained by the city municipal corporation.
Most road damage complaints on city streets fall under the local municipal authority unless confirmed as a highway.

label: Street light issue
submitChecklist: Whether wiring is exposed (call emergency if live wire)

routing.reason: Street lighting on public roads is usually maintained by the municipal corporation.
routing.secondaryReason: If the municipal body delegates to the local electricity board, BESCOM or equivalent may handle repairs.

label: Water supply issue
submitChecklist: Address and connection ID if available

routing.reason: Sewage on roads is a drainage issue handled by the municipal corporation.
Drinking water pipeline leaks are handled by the local water supply board or municipal water department.
Water quality and supply issues go to the water board first.
routing.secondaryReason: If contamination is severe or industrial, the Pollution Control Board may also need to be informed.

routing.reason: Water supply issues are typically handled by the local water board or municipal water department.
Drainage and sewage infrastructure on public roads is maintained by the municipal corporation.
Active late-night noise disturbance should be reported to local police for immediate action.
routing.secondaryReason: Recurring commercial or industrial noise may also require Pollution Control Board complaint.

routing.reason: Night-time noise violations are enforced by local police under noise rules.
Recurring noise from commercial or construction sources is handled by the Pollution Control Board.
routing.secondaryReason: Police can address immediate disturbance even during daytime.

routing.reason: Construction blocking public roads is an encroachment/enforcement issue for the municipal authority.
Unauthorized construction and building violations are handled by the municipal corporation's town planning / building department.
Injured stray animals are often handled by municipal animal welfare cells or NGOs coordinated by the corporation.
routing.secondaryReason: If there is immediate danger or injury to people, contact police.

routing.reason: Aggressive animals posing immediate threat should be reported to police.
routing.secondaryReason: Municipal animal control may assist for stray dog management.

routing.reason: Stray animal nuisance is typically addressed by the municipal corporation's health or animal welfare department.

label: Traffic signal / sign issue
submitChecklist: Photo of broken signal or sign

routing.reason: Traffic infrastructure on national highways falls under NHAI.
Traffic signals and signs in cities are maintained by the traffic police in coordination with municipal/road authorities.
routing.secondaryReason: Municipal body may handle physical maintenance of signal poles.

label: Encroachment / obstruction
submitChecklist: Whether footpath or road is blocked

routing.reason: Footpath encroachment is enforced by the municipal corporation's encroachment or enforcement department.
Public land encroachment is handled by municipal enforcement.
routing.secondaryReason: Police may assist if there is obstruction of traffic or public order issue.
